name: side-drawer
title: Side Drawer
description: Edge-anchored modal that slides in from the right (or left) of the viewport. Composable Header + Body + Footer slots cover three Figma states: Default (header + scrolling sections + CTA footer), Zero State (centered media + title + description + CTA footer), and Custom (free-form body). Built on Radix Dialog for focus trap, ESC, click-outside, and scroll lock. Pixel-perfect port of Figma node 2400:18 (Pantheon › Side Drawer).
